summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness is an open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents with a plugin-driven architecture. It treats every component as a plugin, enabling modular composition of tools, models, and workflows. Its key strength is flexibility: developers can swap or extend capabilities without altering core logic. Typical use cases include creating custom assistants, automating tasks, and prototyping agent pipelines. The 'everything is a plugin' design encourages clean separation and reusability, making it practical for both experimentation and production integrations.
